tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add one Orderly product to the browser cart by shareUrl or SKU. This changes only the cart and does not create an order, collect payment, or start checkout.

shareUrl.description: Orderly product share URL or relative product path.

skuType.description: Orderly SKU type. In Orderly, an SKU is a SKUType plus a SKU value.

quantity.description: Quantity to add. Orderly WebMCP currently supports adding one used item at a time.

tools.name: create_search_alert
tools.description: Prepare a new saved product search with email notifications for matching new arrivals at Orderly. Requires an existing signed-in account and the user to review and submit the form. Does not sign in, edit existing alerts, modify the cart, or start checkout.

tools.name: get_cart_summary
tools.description: Return the current browser cart summary and visible line snapshot. This is read-only and never starts checkout.

refresh.description: Whether to refresh the cart summary from the current stored cart draft.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Resolve one Orderly product by shareUrl or SKU and return product details. Use this before adding an item to the cart when only a SKU or product URL is known.

shareUrl.description: Orderly product share URL or relative product path.

skuType.description: Orderly SKU type. In Orderly, an SKU is a SKUType plus a SKU value.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Return related Orderly products for a known product. Use this for alternatives and similar items; it does not modify the cart.

shareUrl.description: Orderly product share URL or relative product path.

skuType.description: Orderly SKU type. In Orderly, an SKU is a SKUType plus a SKU value.

take.description: Maximum number of related products to return.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Orderly's Danish webshop inventory for used products. Use this for product discovery only; it does not modify the cart or start checkout.

query.description: Search text, including Danish words, author names, brands, ISBNs, categories, sizes, or product titles.

take.description: Maximum number of products to return.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token from a previous search response.

activeTags.description: Optional backend filter tags returned by or known to Orderly search.
